name: do you want to pick up?
source:
You're a kid trying to quit his maybe-unethical job, and end up talking to someone on the other side of the social hierarchy. 

[From [url=https://sardineoil.itch.io/do-you-want-to-pick-up]itch.io[/url]]

你是个正打算辞掉手头这份大概不太道德的工作的年轻人，却阴差阳错地与处于社会阶层另一端的人聊了起来。

[摘自[url=https://sardineoil.itch.io/do-you-want-to-pick-up]itch.io[/url]]
